overview.title: Australian interest rate, line chart, 2019 to 2025.
overview.x_axis: The X axis shows time by year, from 2019 to 2025. Each point is that year's average rate; 2025 averages January to November.
overview.y_axis: The Y axis shows the interest rate as a percentage, from 0 to 5 percent.
overview.data: The line shows the yearly average rate: 1.17 percent in 2019, falling to 0.13 percent in 2021, then climbing to 4.35 percent in 2024 before easing to 3.9 percent in 2025.
overview.summary: Yearly averages fell from 1.17 percent in 2019 to 0.13 percent in 2021, rose sharply to 3.91 percent in 2023, peaked at 4.35 percent in 2024, and eased to 3.9 percent in 2025.
